invention.ref: Yoshio Okada in Osaka invents the world’s first snap-off utility knife, inspired by scored chocolate bars and the edges of broken glass
invention.ref_zh: 日本大阪的冈田良男受巧克力折条凹槽与碎玻璃边缘启发，发明世界上第一把折刃式美工刀

patent.ref: Yoshio Okada granted Japanese patent for the snap-off blade cutting knife
patent.ref_zh: 冈田良男取得折刃式多节刀片切削工具的日本发明专利

mass_production.ref: Okada Kogyo (later OLFA Corporation) begins commercial manufacturing of the Model 1 snap-off cutter in Osaka
mass_production.ref_zh: 冈田工业（后为爱利华 OLFA）在大阪正式量产 1 号折刃美工刀

popularization.ref: OLFA establishes globally used 9 mm and 18 mm snap-off blade standards, making the knife essential for drafting, opening boxes and crafts
popularization.ref_zh: OLFA 确立全球通用的 9 毫米与 18 毫米折刃刀片国际规格，让美工刀成为美工绘图、开箱与手工必备工具

locations.place_label_zh: 日本大阪（冈田良男 / OLFA）

sources.title: Birth of the Snap-off Blade — OLFA Corporation
The History of the Utility Knife — Core77

summary_zh: 1956 年日本 OLFA 创始人冈田良男受折断巧克力的凹槽与碎玻璃启发，发明了折刃式美工刀；随折随新的刀刃彻底解决了传统小刀磨刀的烦恼，成为全球通用工具。
summary_en: In 1956, Japan’s OLFA founder Yoshio Okada invented a snap-off knife inspired by scored chocolate and broken glass. Fresh edges without sharpening made it a worldwide tool.
summary_ja: 1956年、日本のオルファ創業者、岡田良男が、板チョコを折る溝や割れたガラスに着想を得て、折刃式カッターナイフを発明した。刃を折るたびに新しい刃先が現れ、従来の小刀のように研ぐ手間がなくなり、世界で広く使われる道具となった。
